notes.title: Version 1.0.1.18 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Fixes an oversight that allows "New Game" files to start with more encyclopedia character entries than intended.

notes.title: Special Guest NPC! 1.0.1.15 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This is a bit of a special update. We're proud to announce that the one and only Trihex has been added to the game as a special guest NPC in world 4! You can find him hanging around the room with the speedrunning marathon; consider talking to him for some advice if you need it!

Also, another bug related to Thorn's roll has been fixed (seriously, there was another one). There was a very precise location in world 2 (and perhaps other similar locations) where rolling to a wall could soft lock the player. This has been addressed, and should no longer happen.

notes.title: 1.0.1.14 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Fixes another crash connected to Thorn's rolling attack. (Getting hit by a car at the end of your roll with 1 hp would crash the game, but not anymore).

notes.title: 1.0.1.12 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Fixes a crash that occurs when Thorn performs a roll right on top of the charging skeleton enemies.

notes.title: 1.0.1.9 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Due to an oversight while troubleshooting the previous world 6 bug, I accidentally left Steam Achievements disabled for version 1.0.1.8. 
That means achievements weren't working if you played on that version.

This version re-enables them, as well as awarding you any achievements that you didn't get, but earned, during that time.

I sincerely apologize for this inconvenience.

notes.title: 1.0.1.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Prevents a very rare bug that can prevent the player from having access stages after the Jail of the Forsaken area. If you are someone who has encountered this bug, you will need to re-enter the Jail of the Forsaken area and then exit, and the stages should finally appear as intended. As for anyone else, this glitch should never happen again.

notes.title: 1.0.1.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Prevents the player from getting stuck above the ceiling by jumping into the spawning logs in the sub room of 1-14.

2. The block covering the hidden door in 2-18 now moves slower to give the player a chance to notice it before being locked out (and therefore having to reset the level to get inside).

3. Lastly, one of the moving blocks inside the hidden room can no longer become glitched by pausing the game.

Additional changes were made in the previous version, 1.0.1.6:

1. This patch fixes some small tiling errors here and there (such as a vase being partially obscured during the ending sequence and shadows missing in one of the chest sequences).

2. Also prevents the camera from revealing out of bounds if you die to a pit in a certain world 5 stage.

notes.title: 1.0.0.18 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Some small typos have been fixed.

2. The yellow orbs were removed from the end of the "Palace Pathway" stage to prevent it from looking like a Sacred Slab was hidden there.

notes.title: 1.0.0.17 Patch Notes
notes.notes: The Peamen from the second split path in world 1 were mismatched between the sprites found in the stages compared to the sprites on the stage clear screens. This has been corrected.

notes.title: 1.0.0.16 Patch Notes
notes.notes: 1. This prevents the player from getting a crash or a softlock in the Jail of the Forsaken map. Because the cutscene director object was not properly disabled after the cutscene, you could still hold pause to "skip" the regular dialogue interactions with any of the characters in that room. Depending on the situation, you would either get a crash or a softlock. This has been fixed.

notes.title: 1.0.0.15 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Thorn's speed meter will now properly be set back to 0 when you "quit area."

2. The dialogue after the gnome escort mission has been fixed; previously, if you had one space free for items and then received the spore potion, you would still be told "here are some jewels to purchase one after you've made space" despite you having space. This has been fixed.

3. Some typos have been fixed.

notes.title: 1.0.0.14 Patch Notes
notes.notes: There was a rare bug that was preventing some players from unlocking the Ambrosia Forest level. The characters in Oasis Garden behaved as though you already had unlocked it, despite that not being the case. This should fix that issue.

notes.title: 1.0.0.13 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Small bug fixes:

1. Prevented a rat from going into a wall.

2. Fixed a typo from Sarah's dialogue (posses -> possess).

3. Prevented the gnomes from being defeated by the bodies of defeated enemies (this was only possible in very specific cases, such as being DBR15 with the damage upgrade). Obviously, this was not meant to be happening.

4. Fixed a couple instances of the peaman image in the stage clear screen not representing the correct peaman from the stage you just played before.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v. 1.0.0.1–1.0.0.11
notes.notes:
Thank you, Fallen Leaf community, for the continued bug reports and feedback. Fallen Leaf is currently on version 1.0.0.11, the 11th patch since release. We didn't release patch notes for the pre-.11 patches, so I'm compiling them here for future reference.

[b]1.0.0.0[/b]

[list]
[*] Release build,
[/list]

[b]1.0.0.1[/b] | July 15 2024, 12:20pm EST

[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug where Featherhorn shows the wrong button prompt when telling you about fast travel.
[/list]

[b]1.0.0.2[/b] | July 16 2024, 12:11pm EST

[list]
[*] Deactivated loading demo saves for the time being, to avoid a rare but extremely serious game-breaking bug. Demo saves are renamed but kept in the save data folder for now.
[/list]

[b]1.0.0.3[/b] | July 16 2024, 3:06pm EST

[list]
[*] Fix to Steam API functions. Screenshots now work properly, plus the game now pauses when the Steam Overlay is opened.
[/list]

[b]1.0.0.4 and 1.0.0.5[/b] | July 18 2024, 10:50am EST

[list]
[*] Added more dialogue to a certain angelic NPC to make it clear that her comments about a certain "Strange Orb" were not for a quest. This NPC is mainly to point you back to obtaining the Strange Orb if you passed it up your first time.
[/list]

[b]1.0.0.6[/b] | July 18 2024, 4:47pm EST

[list]
[*] Fixed a handful of typos reported by players. Thanks, Discord bug reporters!
[*] Patched some ceiling holes that allowed you to cheese a certain shelled gastropod boss from the ceiling using advanced vertical movement techniques.
[/list]

[b]1.0.0.7[/b] | July 19 2024, 7:03pm EST

[list]
[*] Slight HP buffs to a select handful of bosses who went down too easily in extended community playtesting.
[/list]

[b]1.0.0.8[/b] | July 20 2024, 12:53pm EST

[list]
[*] Fixed a rare but game-crashing bug related to the introductory cave level, gauntlets, and dying in a specific way. Fun fact: while coding this patch, all three devs watched a streamer with 1000+ viewers come a single hit away from the exact steps needed to trigger this crash. To say heart rates were elevated would be an understatement. I think the adrenaline lasted for days.
[/list]

[b]1.0.0.9[/b] | July 20 2024, 3:10pm EST

[list]
[*] The pause button now fast forwards the end-of-level summary screen and also proceeds from it. Before, only the "confirm" button did this.
[/list]

[b]1.0.0.10[/b] | July 21 2024, 9:03am EST

[list]
[*] Slight nerf to DBR15's damage at red and blue power-up levels
[*] Fixed a handful of typos reported by the community
[*] Fixed a hole in the top of a certain sandy level with moving blocks that allowed you to travel on top of the level's ceiling.
[*] Fixed a small visual glitch that failed to render sand on top of a spike deep in a sand pit, which made the spike seem important (it wasn't).
[/list]

[b]1.0.0.11[/b] got its own hotfix post: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1459010/view/4373641964981402708a

notes.title: 1.0.0.11: Small Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when deactivating a certain endgame passive upgrade from the pause menu immediately after loading the game
[*] Fixed a bug where magical weapon description text would not show up in the pause menu when changing tabs with controller buttons
[/list]
